blurb: Visitors can explore one of the world’s largest collections of rotorcraft, including well-preserved rotary-wing aircraft that can be climbed in to experience piloting. The museum offers immersive, multi-sensory activities suitable for all ages. It is an educational and fun experience for aviation enthusiasts and general visitors alike.
